records.title: Frequency-Aware Bias Calibration Attention Network for Hyperspectral Image Classification
records.abstractSummary: Frequency-domain spatial-spectral aggregation suppresses redundant interference; bias-calibrated attention and dual-path frequency interaction recover fine-grained cues and boundaries; abstract reports results on three benchmark HSI datasets.
